'''Wraith Eight''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the eighth member of the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] [[Wraith Squadron]].<ref name="Wraith Squadron" />

[[Garik Loran]] used the call sign "Wraith Eight" from [[7 ABY]]<ref name="Wraith Squadron" /> until 7.5 ABY when it was taken over by [[Voort saBinring]] on Loran's promotion.<ref name="Solo Command">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref>
